kinds.title: The best attack against one of the worst teams
kinds.question: A star blanking against the bottom side, his goal against them, and a bottom side's goal against the best defence.

cards.name: Haaland
cards.note: A blank against a bottom-three side

cards.name: Haaland
cards.note: One goal against the weakest defence

cards.name: Anderson
cards.note: A weak attack's goal against the strongest defence

kinds.verdict: The blank is 4.4. The goal against the weakest defence is marked down to 5.5; the weak side's goal against the best defence is worth 8.6.

kinds.title: A clean sheet, weighed by the attack it kept out
kinds.question: A bottom-half side shutting out a top-four attack should beat a top side shutting out the bottom three.

cards.name: Alderete
cards.note: Bottom-half defender against a top-four attack

cards.name: Canvot
cards.note: Top side's defender against a bottom-three attack

kinds.verdict: 8.1 against 6.1 for the same clean sheet.

kinds.title: Being terrible
kinds.question: Big chances missed and errors should sink a man, whatever else he did.

cards.name: Calvert-Lewin
cards.note: Most big chances missed without scoring

cards.name: Welbeck
cards.note: A missed penalty and no goal

kinds.verdict: 2.0, 1.3 and 1.0. Each big chance missed costs a point before the table, each error leading to a goal two.

kinds.title: The late substitute who scored
kinds.question: A goal off the bench rates well, but his minutes point is one, not two.
kinds.verdict: 7.3: the league gives a short appearance one point, and the mark follows the points.

kinds.title: The keeper who let in three
kinds.question: Conceding three but stopping far more should not sink him.

cards.name: Kelleher
cards.note: Most goals prevented in a match he conceded three

kinds.verdict: 6.5 for the keeper who saved his side from worse, 1.0 for the worst.

kinds.title: A goal from outside the box
kinds.question: Worth a point more than a tap-in.
kinds.verdict: 7.7: the goal's points plus one for the distance.
